title: Hairstyle picker: pick a style by picture, a colour or two and how they mix (Sheet Editor + Character Sheet)
description: A later version, not blocking the release. With no reference picture: a dropdown of hairstyle pictures (hair only, no face or a mannequin), a man/woman filter, a hair colour, an optional second colour, and how the two mix (highlights, gradient...) shown only with a second colour. Hidden when a reference picture is given. Brief: brief.md.
